calculation.description: Reverse each asset's one-day return residual to the cross-sectional median, volatility-scale it, and activate the signal only when trailing cross-asset dispersion is above its trailing one-year median. This is a short-horizon factor and is intended for daily signal ranking despite the 10-day portfolio cadence.

validation.regime_notes: IC/ICIR by regime: 2020-2022 0.037935/0.081629; 2023-2025 0.042979/0.094221; 2026-2031 0.038055/0.116491. Robust positive daily relationship, but predictive power reverses over multi-day horizons; use as a one-day reversal component and monitor overlap with existing CLV/reversal factors.
validation.admission: Passes absolute daily IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR >= 0.0840. Cross-sectional observations require at least 8 valid instruments.
